name: Body and Heart
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone.  The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts.  Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, adventurer... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
narrative.objectives:
Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw.  From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, adventurer. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.

There are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a Druid of the Claw!
narrative.endText: Face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.objectiveText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade.

quests.name: Great Bear Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.

quests.name: Back to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
